customManagers.description: CI and the local VR container run the Playwright image whose browsers match the installed playwright package. Reading the image tag as a version of the npm package puts both in one pull request, and the minimumReleaseAge is then aged by the npm release date (the registry of the image publishes none)

Node 25 and later do not ship Corepack, so the setup-yarn action and Dockerfile.vr install it from npm at a pinned version. Reading that version as an update of the npm package lets Renovate raise the pin like any other dependency

packageRules.description: Rule 1: every update automerges once the required CI passes, 0.x and majors included
Rule 11: pinGitHubActionDigestsToSemver raises each release as a version update; the digest update of the same commit carries no release date and never passes minimumReleaseAge
Rule 4: lock file maintenance has no release dates to wait on (the package manager's age gate holds new versions back) and is never held back by other PRs

Rule 7: published packages raise the lower bound of their dependency ranges. Packages of this workspace stay exact (lerna --exact). Only `dev` publishes new ranges; the previous line keeps exact versions
Rule 8: a peer range keeps its lower bound
engines states the Node.js versions a published package supports; it is raised by hand, not by Renovate (the same as a peer range, rule 8)
resolutions keep their ranges
The storybook package is private, so its dependencies stay exact like devDependencies and do not reach users
hono and zod move together via @hono/zod-validator peer deps
markuplint loads the parsers and specs of its own release, and a parser of a newer major crashes an older CLI while it reports, so the CLI and the @markuplint packages must be raised together
vite-plugin-dts follows vite's peer dependency range, keep aligned with vite bumps

React Compiler's babel plugin, its two bundler integrations (@rolldown/plugin-babel for client, @rollup/plugin-babel for blocks), @vitejs/plugin-react (source of reactCompilerPreset), and their shared babel/typescript-parsing peers must build and type-check together
@types/node is DefinitelyTyped, keep aligned with the volta.node/setup-node bump

The Playwright image tag follows the npm package (see customManagers), so no update of the image itself is raised, and its digest is not pinned: a digest wins over the tag when both are present, so a digest left behind by the tag bump would run the previous browsers against the new playwright package. The registry of the image publishes no release timestamp either, which would keep renovate/stability-days pending forever
Rule 57: the release automation changes how this repository publishes; a person reviews every update

Rule 57: no test renders the video, audio, document and PDF icons of Thumbnail (client/src/components/thumbnail.tsx); a person reviews a major update until a test does (#1237)
Rule 57: no test parses or renders an with the Image extension (custom-element/src/tiptap-extentions/image.ts); a person reviews a major update until a test does (#1238)
release-automation: previous lines take vulnerability fixes and lock file maintenance only
